environment.hardware: CPU (wav2vec2 prototype); YAMNet runs in production on Fly.io CPU

metrics.notes_on_accuracy: YAMNet production model accuracy not measured separately; wav2vec2 prototype accuracy not recorded for 1-epoch run. ECE of 0.172 indicates moderate calibration requiring improvement.

notes: Production inference uses YAMNet (Google, pre-trained, not fine-tuned) via TF Hub. Results are mapped to pet emotional states (distress, attention, excitement, hunger, alert, relaxed) via heuristic class mapping. The wav2vec2 fine-tuning pipeline (facebook/wav2vec2-base) was prototyped for 1 epoch — not yet deployed. Temperature calibration (T=1.5028) applied to the wav2vec2 prototype outputs. ECE=0.172 is higher than ideal; further training recommended.
